scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @story-app/types && npm run build --workspace @story-app/backend && npm run build --workspace @story-app/frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @story-app/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @story-app/frontend"
